The ← arrowhead at about x 3100 points back at this note. A line from about x 3220 to 3420 at the same height runs to 'V b.99(8)ᶜ' on fol. 153. b017 says 'differs from' the same reference, which argues against b016 equating with b017. The attachment is likely to fol. 153 but has not been verified.
The word is cursive: an initial N or K form followed by '-ewari'. The fol. 153 margin fragment of this page shows the same form. The reading is plausible but not secure.
A large tick or caret at about x 410–470, y 2700–2790 spans both the b010 and b012 lines. It does not fix the insertion point.
The digit in parentheses has a 2-like form with a tail. A 3 cannot be completely excluded.
